newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Japan grants Colombia's Ocensa $121 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Japan grants Colombia's Ocensa $121 mln loan.

text.p: Colombia's Oleoducto Central S.A. (Ocensa) has been granted a $121 million credit by the Export- Import Bank of Japan to help finance construction of a new pipeline, Ocensa said in a statement.
It said it would use the 10-year loan to pay off a shorter- term bridge loan that Ocensa had been granted at a less favorable interest rate.
Interest on the Eximbank loan was not specified in the statement.
Ocensa began work in November 1995 on an 800-kilometer pipeline that will connect the giant Cusiana crude oil development in Colombia's eastern plains to the country's Caribbean port of Covenas.
Ocensa said construction of the 556,000 barrel per day pipeline was expected to be completed by the end of next year at a cost of about $2 billion. -- Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
